info.title: UCP Shopping Service
info.description:
Canonical REST interface for UCP Shopping service. Schema references are logical pointers - actual payload shape is determined by negotiated capabilities.

**Endpoint Resolution:** This spec defines operations only. The base URL MUST be obtained from the merchant's discovery profile at `/.well-known/ucp` under `services["dev.ucp.shopping"][transport=rest].endpoint`. The `{endpoint}` server variable below is a placeholder for tooling compatibility.

servers.description: Merchant-provided endpoint from UCP discovery profile

get.description: Get the latest state of a checkout session.

put.description: Update Checkout is a full replacement operation. A new Update Checkout operation is not permitted while Checkout status is `complete_in_progress`. Duplicate requests remain subject to Replay Protection. If the Business receives a new Update Checkout request in that state, it leaves the Checkout unchanged and returns the current Checkout with a recoverable error Message.

200.description: Current Checkout state after the Update request, whether the update was applied or rejected.

get.description: Get the latest state of a cart session.

post.description: Cancel a cart session. Returns the cart state at time of cancellation.
Search for products in the business's catalog.
Lookup one or more products by ID with explicit market context. Supports batch lookups of multiple items in a single request.

get.description: Get the current state of an order. Returns the full order entity as a current-state snapshot. The business verifies the requesting platform created the checkout that produced this order.

200.description: Order retrieved or business outcome message

post.description: Retrieve complete product detail by identifier. Returns a singular product with a relevant set of variants, exact pricing, and real-time availability. Supports interactive option selection via `selected` and `preferences` parameters for variant narrowing and availability signals.

get.description: [Requires the `dev.ucp.shopping.order_consultation` extension to be negotiated; see the extension specification. Proposed, not approved.] MANDATORY authoritative discovery path for actionable consultations. Lists consultations whose current revision matches `status` (default `open`). Notifications never replace it. Follow pagination to exhaustion before concluding that none is actionable.

404.description: `not_found`: unknown identifier, or not visible to this caller (also cross-buyer and cross-Order).

get.description: [Requires the `dev.ucp.shopping.order_consultation` extension to be negotiated; see the extension specification. Proposed, not approved.] Current revision with status, the revision history index, and the authoritative decision receipt once a terminal decision is recorded.

get.description: [Requires the `dev.ucp.shopping.order_consultation` extension to be negotiated; see the extension specification. Proposed, not approved.] Exact immutable terms of one historical or current revision. Only `status` varies over time; the digest recomputes from the terms.

401.description: `identity_required`: absent, expired, invalid, or unverifiable buyer identity token (with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: `not_found`: unknown identifier, or not visible to this caller (also cross-buyer and cross-Order).

post.description: [Requires the `dev.ucp.shopping.order_consultation` extension to be negotiated; see the extension specification. Proposed, not approved.] State-changing. Records exactly one terminal decision against the exact revision in the body. Requires a buyer-authenticated identity token carrying the `dev.ucp.shopping.order_consultation:decide` scope for the Order's owner; Platform credentials, read access, and `dev.ucp.shopping.order:manage` never suffice. Requires Idempotency-Key and Content-Digest; same-key identical-bytes retries replay the original response.

201.description: Decision recorded, or the original response replayed.

401.description: `identity_required`: absent, expired, invalid, or unverifiable buyer identity token (with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: `not_found`: unknown identifier, or not visible to this caller (also cross-buyer and cross-Order).

503.description: `replay_store_unavailable`: failed closed; nothing recorded. Retry with the same key and body.

Not state-changing and not itself idempotency-keyed. Returns `recorded`, `in_flight`, or `not_recorded`; absence is provisional unless `final` is true.

checkout_session_id_path.name: id
checkout_session_id_path.description: The unique identifier of the checkout session.

cart_id_path.name: id
cart_id_path.description: The unique identifier of the cart.

order_id_path.name: id
order_id_path.description: The unique identifier of the order.

authorization.name: Authorization
authorization.description: Should contain oauth token representing the following 2 schemes: 1. Platform self authenticating (client_credentials). 2. Platform authenticating on behalf of end user (authorization_code).

x_api_key.name: X-API-Key
x_api_key.description: Authenticates the platform with a reusable api key allocated to the platform by the business.

signature.name: Signature
signature.description: RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature. Required when using HTTP Message Signatures for authentication. Format: `sig1=:<base64-signature>:`.

signature_input.name: Signature-Input
signature_input.description: RFC 9421 Signature-Input header. Required when using HTTP Message Signatures for authentication. Format: `sig1=("@method" "@path" ...);created=<timestamp>;keyid="<key-id>"`.

content_digest.name: Content-Digest
content_digest.description: Body digest per RFC 9530. Required for requests/responses with a body. Format: `sha-256=:<base64-digest>:`.

idempotency_key.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotency_key.description: Ensures duplicate operations don't happen during retries.

request_id.name: Request-Id
request_id.description: For tracing the requests across network layers and components.

user_agent.name: User-Agent
user_agent.description: Identifies the user agent string making the call.

ucp_agent.name: UCP-Agent
ucp_agent.description: Identifies the UCP agent making the call. All requests MUST include the UCP-Agent header containing the signer's profile URI using RFC 8941 Dictionary syntax. The URL MUST point to /.well-known/ucp. Format: profile="https://example.com/.well-known/ucp".

content_type.name: Content-Type
content_type.description: Representation Metadata. Tells the receiver what the data in the message body actually is.

accept.name: Accept
accept.description: Content Negotiation. The client tells the server what data formats it is capable of understanding.

accept_language.name: Accept-Language
accept_language.description: Localization. Tells the receiver the user's preferred natural languages, often with "weights" or priorities.

accept_encoding.name: Accept-Encoding
accept_encoding.description: Compression. The client tells the server which content-codings it supports, usually for compression.

webhook_timestamp.name: Webhook-Timestamp
webhook_timestamp.description: Webhook event occurrence unix timestamp (seconds since epoch).

webhook_id.name: Webhook-Id
webhook_id.description: The unique identifier of a webhook event.

consultation_status_query.name: status
consultation_status_query.description: Filter by current-revision status. Repeatable. Defaults to `open`.

consultation_original_idempotency_key.name: Original-Idempotency-Key
consultation_original_idempotency_key.description: The Idempotency-Key of the original decision POST being recovered. A header, not a URL parameter, so it stays out of access logs. A lookup argument, not an idempotency key for the lookup. Lookup is scoped to the authenticated Platform, Order, consultation, and the decide operation; it never reveals another Platform's or buyer's decision.

signature.description: RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature for response. Contains the signature value in the format `sig1=:<base64-signature>:`.

signature_input.description: RFC 9421 Signature-Input header for response. Describes signed components, timestamp, and key ID.

content_digest.description: JCS-canonicalized body digest per RFC 8785. Format: `sha-256=:<base64-digest>:`.
